changeRecord.title: section swapped for a lighter one
changeRecord.whyItMatters: A lighter section has less area, inertia and strength. The member's own design ratios rise (capacity falls faster than the demand), and in an indeterminate structure the softer member sheds force to its neighbours, so their demands change too; deflections grow.
changeRecord.precondition: a member for which a lighter section of the same kind exists (in the model or in the generic catalogue of the generators)

reference.note: the reference solution is the analysis (and design) of the perturbed model, once verified

verification.route: benchfea verify: every applicable tier; tier C (two independent solvers) is expected to be able to follow the perturbed model

verification.meaning: 'verified' means only: the reference solution passed every tier listed as applicable in this record, at the tolerances stated in it. It does not mean reviewed, approved or certified by anyone.
